# Other World Studios

> Other World Studios is a Canadian digital agency offering web design, same-day websites, AI automation, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Reddit Ads for businesses across Canada.

- Home: https://www.otherworldstudios.ca/
- About: https://www.otherworldstudios.ca/about/

- Email: otherworldstudios@protonmail.com
- Sitemap: https://www.otherworldstudios.ca/sitemap.xml

## Entity

- Legal/brand name: Other World Studios
- Type: Independent digital agency / professional service
- Country: Canada
- Service model: Remote-first, Canada-wide
- Founded: 2024
- Languages: English

## Services

1. Web design and website development (landing pages and full sites; mobile-first; same-day delivery available)
2. AI automation and AI business consulting (workflows, chatbots, lead routing, custom tools)
3. Digital marketing and paid ads: Google Ads (Search & Display), Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Reddit Ads

## Who it is for

Canadian businesses that need converting websites, practical AI automation, or paid ads without large-agency overhead. Direct access to the person doing the work. Typical enquiry response under 24 hours.

## Geographic coverage

Canada nationwide, including British Columbia (Victoria, Greater Vancouver), Ontario, Alberta, Quebec, and other provinces and territories.
